evidence_quotes.agenda: No quid pro quo framing or agenda question — went straight into date/size screening for a full-pack home move.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: No move-related concern was raised — only scheduling/pricing questions across several candidate dates — scored N/A/full-credit.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: Cleanly routed to a virtual walkthrough given the home size (1700-2100 sq ft) and full-packing request, with a specific day/time confirmed (Wednesday 2:30pm), a link promised, and 'see you tomorrow' as a clear next step — Stage 3 items (estimate, Save Your Ass, close) scored N/A/full-credit per the walkthrough-scheduler rule since a final quote and booking weren't meant to happen until after the walkthrough.

top_strength: Correctly identified this as a walkthrough-appropriate call (large home + full packing) and still gave the customer useful multi-date ballpark pricing while cleanly locking a specific walkthrough day and time.
coaching_note: Damage coverage, Meet Your Mover, and On-Time/Communication were never mentioned anywhere in this call — worth a quick mention even ahead of the walkthrough to start building trust early.
